title: 0643-bettors-reaction-match-dynamics-evidence
universal_lens: The study develops a beta-inflated state-space model to quantify bettor overreaction to match dynamics, demonstrating that NFL in-play betting handle can be modeled as a latent sentiment process. Bayesian event modeling with hidden Markov approximations and penalized likelihood for dynamic stake forecasting under VaEP-driven momentum.
gsi_mapping: The beta-inflated observation model maps directly to GSI's conformal predictive regions for relative betting handle, enabling empirical testing of bettor overreaction hypotheses. GSI employs conformal predictive distributions over relative stakes using BEINF densities and AIC-based model selection to infer latent market sentiment.
gse_mapping: The AR(1) latent sentiment state models NFL game states as a Markov decision process, where bettor reactions constitute strategic actions in a dynamic game. GSE utilizes state-space transitions governed by VAEP differentials and pre-game win probabilities to simulate situational dynamics and betting behavior.

primitives.name: Beta-Exponential-Inflated Finite Distribution
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equations & assumptions - BEINF density: f(y_t) = p if y_t=0; (1-p-q)h(y_t) if 0<y_t<1; q if y_t=1; h beta density; a = μ_t(1-σ2)/σ2, b = (1-μ_t)(1-σ2)/σ2.
primitives.latex: f(y_t) = \begin{cases} p & \text{if } y_t = 0 \\ (1-p-q)h(y_t) & \text{if } 0 < y_t < 1 \\ q & \text{if } y_t = 1 \end{cases}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'y_t': 'relative stake on home team, dimensionless', 'p': 'probability of zero stake, dimensionless', 'q': 'probability of full stake, dimensionless', 'h(y_t)': 'beta density function, dimensionless', 'a': 'shape parameter, dimensionless', 'b': 'shape parameter, dimensionless', 'μ_t': 'mean of beta distribution, dimensionless', 'σ²': 'variance of beta distribution, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Stakes are modeled as discrete outcomes with inflated zeros and ones, approximated by a beta distribution in the open interval.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When y_t approaches 0 or 1, the distribution degenerates into point masses.

layer2.mapping: Used in GSI for probabilistic forecasting of betting intensity; maps to GSE's belief update mechanism through VaEP differentials.
layer2.telemetry: Log-likelihood of observed stakes under BEINF model

reasoning_traces.think: The epistemic foundation of this chapter window rests on the profound divergence between human psychological reaction to sequential events and the algorithmic time-decay models employed by professional bookmakers. Mathematically, we observe a system where the true state of a match is governed by a latent Markov process representing team strength and current momentum. Bettors act as high-frequency observers who drastically overweight the most recent transition kernel—specifically, the Value Added from Expected Points (VAEP) generated in the immediate past. This results in a systematic overreaction, empirically validated by the negative mean returns of simple momentum-based betting strategies that fall well below the standard 5% vigorish. Conversely, bookmakers operate under a vastly different prior. Their pricing engines appear to treat in-play momentum as high-frequency noise, relying instead on a robust time-decay operator where the probability of a home or away win is primarily a function of the remaining clock time and pre-match strength differentials. The case study of HSV vs Werder crystallizes this: despite massive swings in on-field dominance (VAEP), the implied probabilities from odds remain stubbornly anchored to the time-remaining curve. For Galaxy Sports Intelligence (GSI) and the Galaxy Sports Engine (GSE), this dichotomy is not merely an academic curiosity but a foundational arbitrage opportunity. By formalizing the bettor's overreaction as a measurable deviation from the bookmaker's time-decay baseline, we can construct a state-space model that explicitly isolates 'market sentiment' as a distinct, exploitable factor. The porting of this logic to the NFL via EPA/WPA metrics ensures that our sovereign primitives are domain-agnostic, capable of detecting similar behavioral inefficiencies across any sport characterized by discrete or continuous event streams. The absence of held-out predictive validation in the source text necessitates that GSE must implement rigorous conformal inference bounds to ensure these historical overreactions translate into forward-looking probabilistic edges.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This primitive traces its lineage to the seminal work on the Efficient Market Hypothesis and subsequent behavioral finance corrections by Kahneman and Tversky. In sports analytics, it evolves from the early adoption of Poisson distributions for score modeling to the modern era of expected goals (xG) and their dynamic extensions like VAEP. The specific realization that bookmakers ignore short-term momentum while retail bettors chase it represents a maturation of market microstructure theory applied to live sporting events, bridging the gap between classical probability and cognitive bias.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model two distinct classes of agents: the 'Retail Bettor' and the 'Bookmaker Algorithm'. The Retail Bettor possesses a flawed theory of mind regarding the game state, believing that a single high-VAEP event fundamentally alters the long-term trajectory of the match. They suffer from recency bias, continuously updating their priors with excessive weight on the latest observation. The Bookmaker Algorithm, conversely, maintains a cold, Bayesian stance. It understands that while momentum exists, its predictive power over the final outcome diminishes rapidly. It anticipates the bettor's overreaction, setting limits and adjusting prices minimally to capture the excess handle generated by this predictable irrationality, effectively harvesting the vig from emotional decision-making.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition arises if the assumed independence between bookmaker time-decay and true momentum breaks down. If bookmakers begin to aggressively incorporate real-time VAEP/EPA data into their pricing kernels, the arbitrage space collapses. Furthermore, the reliance on proprietary stake data introduces a severe leakage risk; if our proxies for handle (like Betfair volume) are collinear with the odds themselves rather than representing independent sentiment signals, our latent state estimation becomes circular. We must also veto applications in sports with highly irregular stoppages where the 'time remaining' operator loses its monotonic predictive power, rendering the bookmaker's baseline invalid.
